comment: Discord voice: each slot uses its OWN bot (its own Discord application, token read from the named environment variable). 'channel' = the voice channel the bot joins. Default: all bots share one channel ('DayZ') so you can sit there and hear all four overlap like real radio chatter; split them into different channels if you want separate squads. A slot with no token set falls back to the collective bot (DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) in default_channel. See docs/discord_bot_setup_en.md.
